benchmark: Round453 matched full PPO replay after CPU field-feature and validator optimizations
inputs: Exact Round435 20,000-game rollout set; strict preflight offsets and digest reused
finding: The complete PPO replay preserved all metrics and model tensors. Sample collection was 6.05 s (3.58%) faster than Round447; the whole replay was about 3.36 s faster than Round447 but remains slower than Round437’s 217.98 s. One matched replay cannot separate the code change from run-to-run variance or attribute all observed savings to the NumPy encoder; repeat the matched comparison before claiming reliable end-to-end throughput gain.
limitations: This measures a PPO update without self-play game generation, so it does not change the complete-iteration games/s baseline. Round453 includes both the NumPy field-feature path and the flat numeric validation specialization; the standalone 1,026-state benchmark isolates the field encoder with exact input parity.
